title: Langtang ice-rock avalanche, river-dam breach, debris flow & flash flood (cascade)
report_sources: USGS; Nepal Police; UN OCHA; Al Jazeera / CNN / NPR, Aug 2026
notes: Cascading Himalayan hazard: several million m3 of ice and rock detached near 5000 m in the Langtang area, fell ~1900 m, briefly dammed the Bhote Koshi, then breached — sending a debris flow and flash flood ~100 km down the Bhote Koshi / Trishuli, with cross-border impact at Gyirong, China. Figures are provisional and were still rising at time of entry (deaths 489, missing >1500 per Nepal Police, 28 Aug 2026). A barrier lake behind the landslide dam remained a secondary threat. Point location approximate.
